lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We'd propose a 60/40 revenue split in your favour, with an exclusivity of 12 months.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: How many customers could you bring us?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We have around 300 active accounts in that segment.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: How many have actually bought a product like ours before?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Look, the market is moving so fast, everybody is asking about this category, it's really exciting times.
lines.label: evasion

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Let's go back to the split.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Sixty percent to you, forty to us, like I said.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Yes, twelve months. Actually, a quick correction to what I said, it's 300 accounts but only about 120 are active.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: OK, and the split is 60/40 for us?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: It would be 50/50 on revenue, and exclusivity is 24 months.
lines.label: number_drift

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Are you free to partner with our competitors during that period?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Of course, the exclusivity doesn't bind us at all, we can work with anyone.
lines.label: contradiction
